NONE: › a very important person; a person who is treated better than ordinary people because they are famous or influential (= they have a lot of influence) in some way

example: They were in the VIP lounge at the airport.
他們在機場的貴賓休息室。
We were given the full VIP treatment.
我們受到了全套的貴賓禮遇。

NONE: › literary a very unpleasant person who you cannot trust

example: When I started my new job, I didn't realize that I was walking into a nest of vipers.
當我開始新的工作時，我沒有意識到自己已經進了一個蛇蠍之窩。
